canonical_statement: Every closed topological 4-manifold homotopy equivalent to the standard topological 4-sphere is homeomorphic to the standard topological 4-sphere.
domain_and_universes: M : Type u with TopologicalSpace, T2Space, CompactSpace, and ChartedSpace (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 4)) instances; the sphere is Metric.sphere 0 1 in EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 5)

M is unpointedly homotopy equivalent to the standard topological four-sphere
conclusion: Nonempty (M ≃ₜ S^4), the existence of a homeomorphism to the standard topological four-sphere.
